nodes.label: Palindromic rank polynomial iff self-dual poset
nodes.rationale: Stanley's equivalence for a graded poset; Lambda fails both sides at once.

nodes.label: One witness settles both: 5 against 4 one step in
nodes.rationale: Rank sizes read forwards 1, 5, 15, 34, 59, 87 and backwards 1, 4, 10, 21, 37, 57 part company immediately, so F is no palindrome and Lambda admits no rank-reversing automorphism. §8.3's two separate numerical facts — 8 of 976 survivors and an asymmetric rank sequence — are one statement in two languages.
